statement: Authoritative subset repair, authoritative absence, committed partition CDC and full cache reconciliation mutate through one private apply primitive in the existing gateway cache-reconciliation owner. Immediate callers cannot choose old gateway methods or cache delete/remove alternatives. Provenance, error custody, full-observation receipts and durable CDC obligations remain unchanged.

constraints.statement: Follow evidence/design-review.md. Remove all query-execution cache writers, the optional gateway mutation method ladder, and immediate SQL/runtime delete/remove ladders. Use one existing-owner writable capability resolver and tighten the sanctioned direct-call count from two to one without adding allowed files.

Pass operation, original row, causeId and explicit CDC timestamp unchanged. Authoritative absence carries only its owned mutation mode. Subset repair catches and logs each failed row; committed helper propagates to the existing partition catch; full reconciliation still propagates. No subset or CDC path may mint a complete-observation receipt or discharge durable obligations.

The subset Boolean means a usable mutation target accepted the row batch, not that all rows changed or any durable work completed. Prove actual owner entry paths, read-only views with gateway targets, absent ports, throwing retired methods, throwing apply ports, real-cache tombstone/provenance and full receipt controls. Retain prior red guard and independently review exact implementation.
Runtime definition read and eligibility authority, R17 node floor/wake, other corpus failures and E8/E9 remain separate. No deadline, retry, acceptance threshold or guard allowlist is widened.
